wrap_hf_model_as_causal_lm: wrap a HuggingFace model in HgCausalLMAdapter to use with fairseq2 CausalLM training recipes
create_hg_causal_lm_adapter: create an HgCausalLMAdapter from a HuggingFace model with gradient checkpointing enabled
find_embedding_layer: find the embedding layer in a HuggingFace model using common attribute paths
create_attention_mask: create an attention mask from fairseq2 BatchLayout for HuggingFace model input
delegate_hf_attributes: delegate attribute access from HgCausalLMAdapter to the underlying HuggingFace model
